**From:** Ruth Calloway  
**To:** June Osei-Lark; Nadia Fennimore; Gideon Sato  
**Date:** 16 Apr 2026  
**Subject:** Correction: Vantorre handoff date  

June, hold off on the CRM flip.

The Vantorre Group move to Gideon is effective 4 May 2026, not 20 Apr. Nadia keeps it through the Q2 steering commitee on 28 Apr. 

Mateo Quiroga wants the 2nd shift gate log export from the Allentown plant (ticket #8841, dock doors 14-18) reviewed at that meeting, and Nadia already built the deck. No sense swapping chairs four days before they look at the yard turn times.

Gideon, still join the 28 Apr call to shadow, then take the keys on 4 May. June, pls adjust the territory roster accordingly.

—Ruth

***

**Forwarded message**  
**From:** June Osei-Lark  
**To:** Ruth Calloway  
**Date:** 16 Apr 2026  
**Subject:** Re: Territory queue for next wk  

Ruth,

Quick check before I run the batch update tomorrow afternoon. I have VTG queued to move from Nadia Fennimore over to Gideon Sato effective 20 Apr 2026. 

If that's still the plan, I'll swap the billing routing and main point of contact in the portal on Monday morning so Mateo Quiroga sees the update before their Tuesday dock audit. Let me know if anything shifted.

Thanks,  
June
